Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Kamal Singh Yadav,Radhey Shyam Yadav
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for the informant, learned A.G.A. for the
State and perused the record.
2.

The present bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in case crime No.
0401/2023, under Sections 498A, 304B Ipc and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, police station Prem Nagar,
District Jhansi with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
3.  It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant-accused is innocent and he has not committed any offence.
Applicant is husband of deceased.

sentences.text: The incident took place on 17.10.2023 but the first information report was lodged after three days of the incident i.e. on 21.10.2023.
Only general allegations of dowry demand and harassment have been levelled against the applicant and co-accused persons and that no specific role has been assigned to the applicant.
In postmortem report, cause of death of deceased has been found shock due to ante-mortem burn injuries.
From the site-plan of the spot it appears that alleged incident took place accidentally in the kitchen and deceased has sustained injuries by fire from LPG gas.
The applicant was working as constable in Paramilitary Force (S.S.B.) and at the time of incident, he was present at the place of his posting at Tawang Arunachal Pradesh.
After receipt of information regarding incident applicant has obtained earned leave and came by flight.
The marriage of applicant with deceased has taken place about three years prior to the incident and out of that wed-lock, they have two children.
The father of applicant has since passed away and that mother of applicant is suffering from jaundice.
It is further submitted that at the time of alleged incident deceased was living with her minor daughter separately from other family members.
There is no independent witness of alleged incident and there is no eye witness of incident.

Lastly, it was submitted that the applicant is in judicial custody since 23.10.2023, having no criminal history, and that in case applicant is enlarged on bail, the applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail.
4. Learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for the informant have opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that deceased has not sustained the burn injury accidentally and in fact she was put on fire.

On the day of incident, applicant was continuously in contact with deceased through phone and he was pressurizing her to encash the fixed deposit of Rs. 5 lacs which was in her name for construction of new house.
The parents of deceased were informed about the incident by uncle of accused Hajari Prasad.

After incident deceased was taken to hospital and she has sustained 55%
burns but her statement of dying declaration was not recorded.
5.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits, a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

6. Let the applicant Rahul Yadav @ Pappu involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii.
The applicant shall not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant shall not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
7. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.
